title: Settings — status dot centred on the capital letters

steps.path: Settings → the Backup & Sync and Remote Access rows
steps.headline: The dot's middle now lines up with the middle of the capital letter beside it — the S in Sync, the D in Disabled.
steps.changed: Last round's dot still sat about 1.5 px below the middle of the D. It is now positioned from the height of the capital letters themselves, so it stays centred on them whatever font you pick.
steps.measured: Dot raised 1 px in Meadow Mist; its centre now sits within 0.5 px of the D's centre
steps.notice: The dot and the D line up. Use the zoom buttons on the page to compare Before and After closely.
steps.risk: Themes with a different font (Light, Dark, Midnight, Crème) already lined up last round, so nothing moves there. The change is about a pixel, so zoom in to see it.
